name: Shri Niwas Leasing & Finance Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1984, Shri Niwas Leasing and Finance Ltd is engaged in trading in shares, financial services, and investment activities.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2][3]
SNLFL is a Non-Systemically Important, Non-Deposit Taking NBFC that pools funds from multiple investors to invest across various asset classes and financial instruments, distributing returns like interest and dividends proportionally. It is currently engaged in financing, share trading, and investment activities.
